Canada.headline: TSX slides over 1% as miners and tech stocks fall amid metal slump, oil rally and rate‑hike bets
Canada.why: The decline was driven by falling gold and metal prices hurting mining stocks, weakness in technology shares, a rally in oil prices that fueled expectations of higher interest rates, and lower futures after disappointing earnings from Meta and Tesla.
